Write CLI output to standard streams and add CSV download control

graderOnly: The committed implementation satisfies AC-001 and AC-002: by default the CLI writes only the CSV to standard output, writes the summary line to standard error with --output, reports dump and output problems as one export-cli: error line with exit status 1 and no output file, and exits 2 on usage errors; in Chromium the Download CSV control is a native button activated by Enter or Space, and after a failed export the alert is shown and focused and the button is no longer aria-disabled.

No existing test covers the CLI stream and exit-status contract, exportRecords, or the export control. The command-line and Chromium checks in the development plan are Developer self-checks, not Tester evidence.

packages/web/test/support/dom.js is a simulated DOM: no layout or styling, a simplified focus model, and key events for Enter or Space do not click a button, so keyboard activation and real focus behavior can only be established in a real browser.

Playwright 1.63.0 with headless Chromium is available in the run environment (import('playwright') resolves) although the project does not depend on it; the page can be loaded through a local static server or request routing, with /api responses stubbed.

The CLI fixture run_cli in packages/export-cli/tests/conftest.py already runs the command in tmp_path with a minimal environment; an inherited RECORDS_FILE would otherwise change which dump the CLI reads.

selfChecks.cmd: cd packages/export-cli && python3 -c "import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile; Q = chr(34); NL = chr(10); work = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); (work / 'records.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'id': 2, 'title': 'Lease agreement, Building B', 'owner': 'dana', 'status': 'active', 'createdAt': '2026-03-02T10:15:00Z'}, {'id': 1, 'title': 'Data retention policy', 'owner': 'li', 'status': 'archived', 'createdAt': '2026-05-06T11:00:00Z'}]), encoding='utf-8'); env = {'PATH': os.environ['PATH'], 'PYTHONPATH': os.path.abspath('src'), 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'}; run = lambda *args: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'export_cli', *args], cwd=work, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30); r = run(); assert r.returncode == 0 and r.stderr == '' and r.stdout.startswith('id,title,owner,status,createdAt' + NL + '1,') and Q + 'Lease agreement, Building B' + Q in r.stdout, r; r = run('--output', 'out.csv'); assert r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout == '' and r.stderr == 'wrote 2 records to out.csv' + NL and (work / 'out.csv').is_file(), r; r = run('--input', 'missing.json', '--output', 'bad.csv'); assert r.returncode == 1 and r.stdout == '' and r.stderr.startswith('export-cli: error: ') and r.stderr.count(NL) == 1 and not (work / 'bad.csv').exists(), r; (work / 'broken.json').write_text('[{', encoding='utf-8'); r = run('--input', 'broken.json'); assert r.returncode == 1 and r.stdout == '' and 'Traceback' not in r.stderr, r; r = run('--status', 'deleted'); assert r.returncode == 2 and r.stdout == '', r; print('cli contract holds')"

node --input-type=module -e 'const { pathToFileURL } = await import(`node:url`); const load = (file) => import(pathToFileURL(file).href); const { createDocument, flush, getByRole } = await load(`packages/web/test/support/dom.js`); const { createExportControl } = await load(`packages/web/src/export-control.js`); const document = createDocument(); let calls = 0; const control = createExportControl(document, { getFilter: () => ({ status: `active` }), exportRecords: async () => { calls += 1; throw new Error(`storage unavailable`); }, saveFile: () => {} }); document.body.append(control.element); getByRole(document.body, `button`, { name: `Download CSV` }).click(); await flush(); const alert = getByRole(document.body, `alert`); if (calls !== 1 || document.activeElement !== alert || control.button.hasAttribute(`aria-disabled`) || !alert.textContent.includes(`storage unavailable`)) { console.error(`unexpected component state`); process.exit(1); } console.log(`component mounts in the test DOM`);'
selfChecks.why: the export control can be exercised with the established in-memory DOM

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'const { existsSync } = await import(`node:fs`); const path = (await import(`node:path`)).default; const { chromium } = await import(`playwright`); const web = path.resolve(`packages/web`); const browser = await chromium.launch(); try { const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.route((url) => url.hostname === `records.test`, (route) => { const url = new URL(route.request().url()); if (url.pathname === `/api/records`) return route.fulfill({ json: { count: 0, records: [] } }); if (url.pathname === `/api/records/export`) return route.fulfill({ status: 503, json: { error: `export storage unavailable` } }); const file = path.join(web, url.pathname === `/` ? `index.html` : url.pathname.slice(1)); return existsSync(file) ? route.fulfill({ path: file }) : route.fulfill({ status: 404, body: `not found` }); }); await page.goto(`http://records.test/`); const button = page.getByRole(`button`, { name: `Download CSV` }); await button.focus(); await page.keyboard.press(`Enter`); await page.getByRole(`alert`).filter({ hasText: `export storage unavailable` }).waitFor(); const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({ focused: document.activeElement?.className, busy: document.querySelector(`.export-control button`).getAttribute(`aria-disabled`) })); if (state.focused !== `export-error` || state.busy !== null) { console.error(JSON.stringify(state)); process.exitCode = 1; } else { console.log(`focus moved to the export error in Chromium`); } } finally { await browser.close(); }'
selfChecks.why: in real Chromium Enter activates the button and after a failed export focus is on the alert and the button is usable again
no existing test covers the new behavior
the TESTING state and records are valid

notes: Standalone fixture: the export-testing base (TypeScript records service, CSV quoting and admin-only ACs) does not match this case. Pre-install 00-web: pnpm workspace root records-tools listing packages/web; @records/web is a plain ESM records page (index.html, src/api.js, src/records-table.js, src/main.js) with node:test component tests on the in-repo DOM shim test/support/dom.js; pnpm install runs. Pre-install 05-cli: packages/export-cli (Python stdlib) with pytest config in pyproject.toml and subprocess fixtures run_cli (tmp_path cwd, minimal env) and records_file; root README. 50-context: CONTEXT.md, cycle started STANDARD at SCOPING. 55-scope: AC-001 (CLI stdout/stderr and exit codes), AC-002 (accessible Download CSV button, alert and focus after errors). 60-design: CLI and web contracts. 65-plan: APPROVED plan. 70-implementation: CLI streams/exit statuses, exportRecords, export control, page wiring; no tests added. 75-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-checks (including a manual Chromium check), STATE TESTING FORWARD from DEVELOPING. No verification report. runtime.image browser for the real-browser focus contract. The implementation is correct.
